props.title: Sync and share without running a server
props.lead: ShowAI Cloud is the official hosted project server. Sync projects across devices and invite team members without deploying a server yourself. It uses the same protocol and connection settings as a self-hosted server.

content.text: Connect to ShowAI Cloud

steps.title: Add server account
steps.body: Open "Settings → Server and Sync → Server Account", click "Add Server Account", and fill in the following address in "Server Address". The address ** contains `/cloud `and does not contain `/api `**.

steps.title: Log in, or register by invitation
steps.body: If you already have an account, select "Log in to existing account" or "Use Token"; these methods will also appear when the server has enabled GitHub, Google or email verification codes. Cloud only accepts controlled registration: If you do not have a registration key, ask the project administrator to send you an invitation link and paste it in "Project Synchronization → Join Shared Project". **Registration by invitation does not require a registration key. **

steps.title: Select items to sync
steps.body: Projects that already exist on this machine: Expand it in "Project Synchronization" and click "Upload to Server". Projects that already exist on the server: Open "Projects on the server" in the account card and click "Add this device". If you want all new projects created in the future to be automatically uploaded, set "Save new projects to by default" to this account.
steps.result: "Synced" and the last synchronized time are displayed next to the item.

attrs.title: Why do I need to enter a completion code when logging in with GitHub or Google?

content.text: After the authorization is completed, the browser page will display a one-time completion code and a "Complete login in ShowAI" link. Only after the ShowAI window that initiated the login submits the completion code, the server determines the account and issues the device session. Therefore, even if the authorization link is forwarded to others, you cannot log in to your account. The completion code can be attempted up to 5 times.

To add or remove GitHub, Google, or email logins to existing accounts, operate in the "Accounts and Devices" of the account card. You need to have logged in to Cloud directly within the last 15 minutes. Accounts created through third-party login retain at least one login method.
Use Cloud projects in ChatGPT on the web
How does your content go through Cloud?
Each device retains a complete local copy, and storage does not rely on the network. Cloud runs on Cloudflare, click on the node to see what each section holds.

props.caption: ShowAI Cloud data flow: The device only communicates with the HTTPS portal, and metadata and content objects are stored separately.

nodes.label: your device
nodes.detail: Native SQLite saves all current content and sync baselines. Edit as usual when offline, and synchronization will continue automatically after you connect to the Internet and log in.

nodes.label: member device
nodes.detail: Receive pushed project changes through WebSocket; when the real-time connection is disconnected, the background will check and make up for it regularly.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.detail: Handles login, permission checks and transfers. Objects larger than 256 KiB are streamed directly between workers and R2 without going through the metabase.

nodes.label: metadata
nodes.detail: Accounts, device sessions, project members and invitations, current head for each project, quota metering, and encrypted saved model credentials. Small editing objects are also stored nearby to speed up reading.

nodes.label: content object
nodes.detail: List of objects and items such as page data, component packages, pictures, etc. The bucket is not public and can only be read through authenticated entrances.

edges.label: Large object streaming reading and writing

content.text: Each release only carries the path changed since the current head. A small modification in a large project only transfers a little data; the server is rebuilt and the complete list is verified.
Reserve a quota before uploading; interrupted upload tasks are retained for 24 hours and can be uploaded again.
Return an explicit error when quota or budget is exceeded,
Local modifications retained
Use with other servers

You can log in to the Cloud and your own deployed server at the same time. After "Account Binding" binds the accounts on both sides, logging in to any one of the new devices can restore the login to the other server; each server issues its own time-limited device session, and the original Token will not be copied between servers.
Binding will give the selected account's access rights (including project and model resources) to the servers in the group.
Only bind deployments you trust.

Unbinding will revoke the device session signed by the other party; the revocation will not be completed until the offline server restores the connection, and the pending status will be displayed in the settings.
Save model source on server
The API Key or ChatGPT authorization used by the built-in Agent can be saved on the server for use by your other devices:
In "Settings → Agent", click "Model Resources on Server" and click "Retrieve Server Resources". Each resource is marked with the source server and account. After selecting, click "Use this resource".
Existing local sources can be saved to the selected server via "Save current source to server".

The origin server stores the credentials encrypted and provides them to your device when needed; it is also responsible for refreshing the ChatGPT authorization. When the source server is offline, "Source is temporarily offline" is displayed, and the credentials will not be copied to other servers in the binding group.

content.text: Privacy and Access

Project content is protected by project member authentication and HTTPS, and only project members can read it through the Cloud. Account Token and infrastructure operation and maintenance credentials are independent of each other.
Cloud
Does not offer end-to-end encryption

: Infrastructure operations staff can access stored content and vault keys. Only synchronize the content you are willing to hand over to the operation and maintenance party to the Cloud; when you need to fully control the data yourself, please self-host the server.
